Create a router. Its `mode` is required and can't change afterwards:

- `proposal`: your app sends its request to `POST /v1/route`, gets back the router's ranked candidates, and calls the chosen model itself, with its own keys. A Proposal Mode router takes no providers or keys.
- `gateway`: your app sends its requests to the gateway (`https://api.withemissary.com/gateway`) with `model` set to the router's name, and Emissary serves the model it picks with the provider keys stored on the router. Every enabled model needs a `provider`, and every provider the models name needs a key in `providers`.

A model entry needs only its `name` (and, on a gateway router, its `provider`). What it leaves out comes from the router model's catalog (`GET /v1/router-models`): prices, context window, vision support, and `model_id` (the model's name on a Proposal Mode router, its id at the chosen provider on a gateway router).
